objective.primaryRule: NL0 1.0.0 §3.5 original rule: the actual-profit role among the Q1-Q6 qualified members (highest centre net; ties: higher selection robust net, lower centre DD, label); per cutoff for Track F's populations (F: the procedure; L, B report-only) and at C24 for N and U (U's primary = the study's formal C24 primary). The successor determination (PROTOCOL.md §12) is a separate precommitted governance label.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 initial trading allocation (not peak account equity); P0 = 35 % of it; trade principal loss, banked-capital DD and giveback are report-only

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres; refinement moves apart): Track F configured base 256 lanes x (512 + 2 x 256) = 262,144 per cutoff (4 cutoffs: 1,048,576) plus refinement and Track N designs and islands (PROTOCOL.md §7.6); the figure above is a planning order (base Track F proposals x 2). Backend evaluations: the hard ceiling of 80,000,000 requested official evaluations (archive hits included; fresh and hits reported separately; ledger over the sealed stage records); every stage is bounded deterministically by its lanes' worst cases (PLC broad 90,000 / refine 174,000 / informed 171,000), 655 per qualified member, 306 per slice subject.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation (search, replicate rounds, qualification, fold slices, validation) runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted GPU Phase 7 evaluator (record sha256 bb0e3fcf..., binary gb7 cb2ff30b..., RTX 5090 GPU-ae5f222c...), node --no-maglev, one held job per stage; no CPU fallback. Engineering gates, the pilot and report-only diagnostics are non-official (parity-test / benchmark / cpu-reference / diagnostic).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 3.0.0 §1.8 default, adopted: a failed or uncomputable independent verdict of the F/original procedure means 'no chronological support: the selection is not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision'; every Track N and U selection is 'incumbent-informed; no independent chronological test' with the same consequence. Governance only. 'No material improvement' is a valid outcome.

deviations.description: Assignment 3's 92-gene full joint space (64 D1 risk-control cells x Growth·VGT's complete Growth 1.4.0 genome) imported unchanged; Growth·GDX OFF; S1 absent from the engine (the S1-free GPU Phase 7 revision); shadow-entry eligibility OFF; calendar-day holds.

Effort by replicates of NL0's unchanged per-lane schedules: Track F 4 base replicates per cell and cutoff, 4 refinement lanes per refined cell, Track N R_N replicates per family pair by Assignment 3's matching rule.
deviations.justification: NL0 §7.4 scaling; the brief requires an independently sufficient budget for both tracks (§3.3).

deviations.description: Two-tier island extension (NL0's full trigger up to NL0's caps 6/8, then performance components only up to 16 islands) and convergence-driven replicate rounds (one replicate of every structure while the track's union improves > 2 % or a structure gets its first feasible fit; <= 4 rounds).
deviations.justification: Brief §3.3.4-§3.3.7 (caps high enough to avoid Priority 4's 48 % budget-bound outcome; multiple predeclared extension rounds); Phase A: the class component alone kept 142/185 Assignment 3 lanes at their caps with ~0 performance gain.

deviations.description: The sequential drawdown statistic is computed exactly from GPU outputs (each slice's minute reset drawdown, every session close, every lot's minute minimum); the CPU reference exact minute chain is reported beside it, non-official.
deviations.justification: The accepted GPU path returns no minute mark series; a CPU-scored official statistic is forbidden (§9.2). Gate E6 measures the gap.

deviations.description: FULL is read before the frozen selection only for the known-target reproduction of New L0 and N/original (gate E2, equality output only).
deviations.justification: Assignment 3 AD3 / GPU Phase 1 AD3 precedent; the references' full-history figures are published.

deviations.description: NL0's original rule is the only selector; Assignment 3's RA1/RA2 (which needed a user-agreed departure) are not used; the refinement plan's RA1 slot is replaced by NL0's balanced statistic.
deviations.justification: No departure is granted by this brief.

deviations.description: Track N (incumbent-informed, C24 only): Assignment 3's informed machinery with N/original as its only seed projected onto every family pair; N/original and New L0 are incumbent members of N and U.
The neighbourhood instrument, seed namespace and labels are Assignment 3's, so the references' C24 evidence reproduces Assignment 3's sealed evidence (gate E2).

Precommitted successor determination against N/original (material improvement P or R with $10,000 / $5,000 / $2,500 bands, replication across seeds, V1-V3) — governance labels only.
deviations.justification: Brief §7 (material improvement and uncertainty criteria before optimization).
